raw.details:
UNIVION: CHRONOS DE NOVO

National-Level 36-Hour Hackathon | SIEEDS Foundation

About the Event

UNIVION: CHRONOS DE NOVO is the flagship national-level hackathon organised by the SIEEDS Foundation (SIEEDS4SAGE), scheduled for 15-16 January 2027 at IIT Delhi. The event brings together student developers, researchers, engineers, designers and innovators from across India to build technology-driven solutions to real-world challenges.

The hackathon promotes interdisciplinary collaboration, innovation and practical problem-solving across six frontier technology domains.

Join the Community: https://chat.whatsapp.com/DGsE276ouD0G8n2WZkkjvX

Tracks

  1. Artificial Intelligence: Machine learning, generative AI and intelligent automation.

  2. Quantum Computing: Quantum algorithms, simulation and quantum information processing.

  3. Quant Finance: Algorithmic trading, financial modelling and risk analytics.

  4. Web3: Blockchain, decentralised applications and digital identity.

  5. Robo-Autonomics: Robotics, embedded systems and autonomous technologies.

  6. Cybersecurity: Cryptography, network security and threat intelligence.

Eligibility & Team Formation

  • Open to undergraduate and postgraduate students from recognised institutions across India.

  • Inter-college and interdisciplinary teams are permitted.

  • Participants must provide valid institutional identification when required.

  • Each participant may register with only one team.

  • Final team-size requirements will be specified in the official registration guidelines.

Competition Format & Timeline

The competition will consist of two rounds:

Round 1: Online Submission Round

  • 26 November 2026: Registrations and submissions open.

  • 26 December 2026: Submission deadline.

  • 4 January 2027: Finalist announcement.

Round 2: Offline Grand Finale

  • 8 January 2027: Finalist onboarding.

  • 15-16 January 2027: 36-hour Grand Finale at IIT Delhi.

Approximately 100 finalist teams will be shortlisted from the online round to compete in the offline finale.

Evaluation Criteria

Projects will be assessed on:

  • Innovation and originality.

  • Technical implementation and complexity.

  • Practical applicability and feasibility.

  • Scalability and potential impact.

  • Prototype quality and demonstration.

  • Presentation and clarity.

Rules & Guidelines

  • All participants must register through the official platform and provide accurate information.

  • Projects must align with the selected technology track.

  • Plagiarism, misrepresentation and unfair practices are strictly prohibited.

  • Third-party APIs, datasets, libraries and open-source components must be disclosed.

  • Teams must adhere to submission deadlines and evaluation guidelines.

  • Participants attending the offline finale must comply with IIT Delhi campus protocols.

  • Organisers reserve the right to modify operational arrangements when necessary.
